verdict.summary: The new opt-in example correctly times the real VectorIndex::build_with path without including corpus-store creation or index destruction in build_s, retains the built index through black_box, streams bounded raw-f32 input into VectorStore, and labels output provenance and non-canonical timing limitations honestly. Argument defaults and documented invocation agree, the approx-ann feature gate is correct, and --smoke exercises actual store finalization and all three shipped HNSW preset builds. The existing recall-floor test cited by the documentation exercises the same real build path; this PR does not claim that smoke validates recall. No correctness, soundness, security, vacuous-test, or completeness defect requiring changes was found.
